data.name: label_startupDescription.Text
data.value:
The application can be run automatically when the user logs on.
This is achieved by creating a shortcut file in this user's startup folder.
If you wish to run it automatically on startup, please click on "add entry".
If you wish to not run it automatically anymore, please remove the shortcut in the startup directory.

data.name: label_imageDescription.Text
data.value:
The background image is stored in a file in the application's folder. You can change the image either by selecting a new one here or by replacing the file manually.
file name: background (without extension)
